mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations by increasing discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days in any regime.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.5% (as of t-1mo), or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.5%, it signals labor market deterioration and recession risk, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE indicate stagflation, which is highly bearish for equities, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.5% and UNRATE > 4.5%, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing and retail sales contraction (HOUST < 1500 and RSAFS < 750000), S&P 500 underperforms over the next 60 days due to weak consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1500 and RSAFS < 750000, or regime Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher CPIAUCSL index values (above 330) reflect persistent inflation, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 330, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals manufacturing contraction, which precedes economic slowdown and causes negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market conditions (PAYEMS > 158000) support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 158000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1500 thousand units (HOUST < 1500) indicate a cooling housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1500, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
